caption:
One hour every Sunday tells you whether your shop truly made money this week. The slides break that hour into four parts: collect the week's statements, record money in and money out, reconcile settlements against orders, and end with one number plus one decision for the week ahead.

Save this and run it this Sunday. Sellers who know their numbers weekly make festival-season decisions in minutes while everyone else guesses.

#OnlineSellingIndia #EcommerceIndia #SmallBusinessIndia #Bookkeeping #SellerTips
